prompt: Write a three paragraph biography for Australian Film Producer Drew Bailey, list his oscar nominated film and his time as an assistant director.
response: Drew Bailey is an accomplished Australian film producer, known for his work on numerous critically acclaimed films. He began his career as an assistant director on the set of "The Great Gatsby," directed by Baz Luhrmann. Bailey's production company, Silver Screen Productions, has produced several award-winning films, including "The Rocket," which was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
